description: mergeConfigPatch(base, patch): `output` is the merged Config re-parsed through ConfigSchema, or {error: {kind, message}}. Objects merge per key; arrays and non-objects replace; a path matching REPLACE_WHOLESALE (providers.*.extraHeaders, tools.mcpServers.*.env, tools.mcpServers.*.headers, agents.list.*, extensions.settings.*) replaces the whole value; a null at a path matching DELETE_BY_NULL (providers.*, tools.mcpServers.*, tools.mcpServers.*.oauth, agents.list.*, extensions.settings.*) removes the key; a null anywhere else is a value the schema rules on. A chained scenario records one case per step with the previous step's result as `base`. Note: JSON cannot carry `undefined`, so the "undefined means not mentioned" rule has no case here.
